# std.encoding

<!-- Generated by `badger doc std` from the checked interfaces (badger 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Text encodings of bytes and text: base64 (standard, or URL-safe without
padding), hex, and URL percent-encoding. The `badger_crypto` native module
encodes.

## Types

### `Error`

```badger
struct Error { pub message: String }
```

Input that is not in the encoding.

```badger
fn display(self: &Self) -> String
```
